purpose: Capture item rule of docs/evals/generic-reader-protocol.md (generic-reader-protocol.2): the first in-stock eligible item whose displayed price, in the storefront's currency, lies within [min, max] major units. Each band approximates USD 10-200.
basis: Rounded approximate exchange rates from the builder's knowledge (claude-code/claude-opus-5-5), not fetched and not FX data. A band that is off by 20% only changes which item is picked; it never enters a label or a score. Never edited after the protocol is signed; a currency missing here is added by a dated amendment before its first capture.
